'''Clue scroll (master)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (master)|master]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 906
|text = The clue reveals who to speak to:<br><br>Come brave adventurer, your sense is on fire. If you talk to me, it's an old god you desire.
|items = Equip a [[ring of visibility]] or [[ring of shadows]] and a [[ghostspeak amulet]].
|equipment1 = Ring of visibility or Ring of shadows
|equipment2 = Ghostspeak amulet
|notes = Speak to [[Viggora]]. Note that he can be found (is visible) in 3 locations, but you can only speak to (and continue the clue) the version of him that you spoke to during [[Curse of the Empty Lord]] [[miniquest]]. You can check your quest log to find out which location. 
*[[Paddewwa]], [[Edgeville Dungeon]], near the [[earth warrior]]s.
*{{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Rogues' Castle]] in the deep [[Wilderness]].
*{{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Canifis]] [[Slayer Tower]], just before the [[Infernal Mage]].
